solucao.p: $\frac{\partial}{\partial y} (2xy + z^{3}) = 2x = \frac{\partial}{\partial x} (x^{2} + 2yz); \frac{\partial}{\partial z} (2xy + z^{3}) = 3z^{2} = \frac{\partial}{\partial x} (y^{2} + 3xz^{2} - 1)$; $\frac{\partial}{\partial z} (x^{2} + 2yz) = 2y = \frac{\partial}{\partial y} (y^{2} + 3xz^{2} - 1)$; so $\vec{F}$ is conservative.
